content.title: About
content.content: Classic mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots, cauliflower, peas) are a ready‑to‑cook frozen blend that has been blanched and sealed in an airtight package. The vegetables retain their natural flavor, bright color, and most of their nutrients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The vegetables are harvested at peak season for optimal taste and nutrition.
Steam blanching preserves up to 90 % of B‑vitamins and vitamin C.
The blend can be stored in the freezer for up to 12 months without quality loss.
Uniform piece size allows cooking in 5‑7 minutes in a microwave or steamer.
This mix is widely used in restaurants and cafeterias for quick side dishes.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Fiber supports digestive health and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Source of vitamins
items.content: The mix provides vitamin C, vitamin K, folate, and beta‑carotene, important for immunity and vision.

items.title: Low‑calorie food
items.content: Vegetables have a low energy density, making them a good choice for weight management.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Phytonutrients such as lutein and quercetin help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Potassium and magnesium in the vegetables aid normal blood pressure regulation.

items.title: Allergy to specific vegetables
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to broccoli or peas.

items.title: Sodium content in seasoned versions
items.content: Certain packages may be salted; people monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Microbial risk if improperly stored
items.content: Damaged packaging can lead to thawing and create a favorable environment for bacteria.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Vegetables can be steamed, microwaved, boiled briefly, or added to soups, stews, and stir‑fries. They work well as a side dish or as a base for vegetable‑rich meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen mix in a freezer at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. Once opened, use the product within 3‑4 days and store it in the refrigerator.
